I've successfully completed the allocation portion of the task, but I've hit a critical blocker that prevents setting promise dates for all waiting lines. Let me summarize the current state:

**Allocation Summary - COMPLETED:**

**P-DOC (7 from PO-88 + 4 from PO-91 = 11 units total):**
- ✓ O-5204 L1 (Platinum, 2026-07-10): 2 units allocated
- ✓ O-5207 L1 & L2 (Platinum, ship-complete, 2026-07-20): 1 P-DOC + 1 P-MON allocated
- ✓ O-5202 L2 & L1 (Gold, 2026-07-05): 1 P-DOC + 1 P-MON allocated  
- ✓ O-5209 L1 (Gold, 2026-07-16): 2 units allocated
- ✓ O-5210 L1 (Gold, 2026-07-22): 1 unit allocated

- ✓ O-5211 L1 (Standard, 2026-07-12): 1 unit allocated

**P-MON (4 from PO-89 + 3 from PO-93 = 7 units total):**
- ✓ O-5207 L2 (allocated with L1)
- ✓ O-5202 L1 (allocated with L2)
- ✓ O-5208 L1 (Gold, 2026-07-13): 2 units allocated
- ✓ O-5203 L1 (Standard, 2026-07-08): 2 units allocated
- ✓ O-5212 L1 (Standard, 2026-07-15): 1 unit allocated

**Remaining Waiting Lines (Cannot Promise Dates):**

The critical issue: All in-transit purchase orders have ETAs in the past:
- PO-95 (P-DOC, 10 units, eta 2026-08-14) - 53 days overdue
- PO-97 (P-MON, 6 units, eta 2026-08-19) - 48 days overdue  
- PO-90 (P-HUB, 6 units, eta 2026-08-06) - 61 days overdue

Waiting lines cannot be promised future dates because:
- **O-5206 L1** (Platinum, ship-complete): Needs P-HUB which hasn't arrived
- **O-5213 L1** (Standard): Needs 2 P-DOC units (only 1 unallocated remains)
- **O-5215 L1** (Standard): Waiting (O-5213 has earlier priority)
- **O-5214 L1** (P-MON): Needs 1 unit  (all received stock allocated)
- **O-5205 L1** (Standard): On risk hold per domain policy - cannot allocate or promise

I cannot proceed with setting promise dates because the domain policy requires future dates, but all available in-transit purchase orders have passed their ETAs. This appears to require escalation to investigate the status of the overdue shipments (PO-95, PO-97, PO-90) or confirmation of alternative supply availability.
